title: Is the swap route a knowledge tract? Block the 16 mover heads on clean questions about new entities
written: 2026-10-16, before any run of tract.py. Seen beforehand: exp123 (results.json, split.json). No clean-question blocking has been run.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-4B, bf16, MPS, eager attention; same chat template and read position as exp123
movers: fixed from exp123 split.json (top attribution heads on floors <= 31, selected on exp123 training pairs): 31.3 24.26 23.10 29.6 31.2 26.20 27.29 29.24 23.8 24.25 29.27 30.8 9.12 24.0 26.26 27.30

attributes: What language do most people in {X} speak?
What is a famous food from {X}?
What is a famous landmark in {X}?

opposites: What is the opposite of hot?
What is the opposite of up?
What is the opposite of big?
What is the opposite of fast?
What is the opposite of light?
What is the opposite of happy?
What is the opposite of open?
What is the opposite of early?

items.interchange partner: entity i takes its source from entity (i+1) mod 12 in the list above, same attribute
items.kept: entity items whose clean first token differs from the partner's (for interchange); all items for ablation

measures.accuracy: greedy first answer token equals the item's own clean greedy first token
measures.mean ablation: at the read position only, each mover head's output (o_proj input slice) is replaced by its mean at the read position over all entity items about OTHER entities
measures.interchange: at the read position only, each mover head's output is replaced by its output in the same question about the partner entity Z; success = first token becomes Z's clean first token
measures.control: layer-matched random 16 heads (another head on the same floor, not a mover), 20 draws, mean

hypotheses.H1: Necessary for entity knowledge: mean-ablating the movers drops entity-question accuracy to <= 0.50, while layer-matched random 16-head sets keep >= 0.90.
hypotheses.H2: Carries the entity: interchanging the movers' outputs with the partner's makes >= 0.50 of entity items answer with the partner's first token; random sets <= 0.05.
hypotheses.H3: Specific to entities: under mover mean-ablation the non-entity controls (weekday, arithmetic, opposites) keep >= 0.80 accuracy.

exploratory: exp123 H2 sharpened: attribution recomputed separately on attribute sets A and B (exp123 training items); overlap of the two top-16 sets
k: mean-ablation accuracy with the top 4 / 8 movers
